title: Specificity-Guided Knowledge Diversion for Decomposable Generative Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.21352v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Generative model pre-training typically optimizes a model as a whole without explicitly organizing its parameters for selective reuse. Decomposable pre-training instead learns reusable components for downstream adaptation while retaining strong generative performance. However, existing knowledge diversion methods incur substantial parameter overhead through weight factorization and rely on fixed component assignments to induce specialization, potentially compromising in-distribution generation quality. We therefore propose Specificity-Guided Knowledge Diversion (SGKDiv), which learns how generative knowledge is shared and specialized for effective generation and selective downstream reuse. SGKDiv constructs Knowledge Units from paired feed-forward channels, preserving native computational structure without SVD-based reparameterization. translated_title: 面向可分解生成模型的特异性引导知识分流
translated_abstract: 生成模型预训练通常将模型作为一个整体进行优化，而没有显式地组织其参数以供选择性复用。可分解预训练则学习可复用的组件用于下游适配，同时保持强大的生成性能。然而，现有的知识分流方法通过权重分解会带来大量参数开销，并且依赖固定的组件分配来诱导专门化，这可能损害分布内的生成质量。因此，我们提出了特异性引导知识分流（SGKDiv），它学习生成知识如何被共享和专门化，以实现有效的生成和选择性的下游复用。SGKDiv 从成对的前馈通道构建知识单元，在不进行基于 SVD 的重新参数化的情况下保留原生的计算结构。校准的按条件路由将共享使用先验与条件调整相结合……
tldr: 提出 SGKDiv 方法，通过将成对前馈通道构建为知识单元并采用校准的条件化路由，在不引入参数开销和 SVD 重新参数化的情况下学习生成知识的共享与专门化，从而在保持分布内生成质量的同时支持选择性的下游复用。
en_tdlr: We propose SGKDiv, a specificity-guided knowledge diversion framework that constructs Knowledge Units from paired feed-forward channels with calibrated condition-wise routing, learning shared and specialized generative knowledge without parameter overhead or SVD reparameterization, thereby preserving in-distribution generation quality while enabling selective downstream reuse.
